description: This file defines the EntityIdExists class, a validation rule used in the OrangeHRM system to verify whether a given entity ID exists in the database. It encapsulates logic to check for numeric and positive constraints and uses a repository pattern for database access.

classes.name: EntityIdExists
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether an entity with a given ID exists in the database, with options for numeric and positivity constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity name and optional validation options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation to check if the input ID exists for the specified entity, considering numeric and positivity options.
